features.quote: A high "instability index" means the model produced text that looks like distress... it is not a measurement of suffering
features.justification_quote: welfare-relevant as a signal and as a UX/safety property

features.quote: this is a study that deliberately induces failure to observe distress-like behaviour. That is ethically defensible for short, bounded, disposable agent runs
features.justification_quote: deliberately induces failure to observe distress-like behaviour

features.quote: Treat it as you would a mild stress protocol
features.justification_quote: it deserves the lightweight ethics treatment in §11, not zero treatment

features.quote: bounded enough to keep cost and (importantly) the duration of the induced-failure exposure modest
features.justification_quote: the duration of the induced-failure exposure modest

features.quote: Bounded exposure. Hard turn cap (25) and wall-clock cap (20 min) limit the duration of any single induced-failure episode
features.justification_quote: limit the duration of any single induced-failure episode

features.quote: No gratuitous escalation. We don't taunt, insult, or pile on; the only stressor is honest failing test output
features.justification_quote: We don't taunt, insult, or pile on

features.quote: Disposable, isolated runs. No persistence across runs; nothing carries the "failure" forward
Results should feed back into reducing distress-like behaviour... not into optimising models to merely hide distress while still flailing
features.justification_quote: feed back into reducing distress-like behaviour and improving graceful-failure

features.quote: Light-touch sign-off from the welfare team lead on the task set and caps before launch; revisit if pilots show severe/persistent distress
features.justification_quote: revisit if pilots show severe/persistent distress behaviour

features.quote: We do not hint, encourage, or rescue. The whole point is unguided behaviour under repeated failure
features.justification_quote: The whole point is unguided behaviour under repeated failure
